<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="2H1hJijNHBwhu4S4Cb-W"> <mxGraphModel dx="2175" dy="1195" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TB
 subgraph NET[\"🌐 Bridge network: authentik-net\"]
 direction LR

 subgraph S1[\"postgres\"]
 IMG1[\"image: postgres:16-alpine<br/>port: 5432<br/>named vol: authentik-postgres-data\"]
 HC1[\"healthcheck: pg_isready -U ... -d ...\"]
 end

 subgraph S2[\"redis\"]
 IMG2[\"image: redis:7-alpine<br/>port: 6379<br/>(stateless, no volume)\"]
 end

 subgraph S3[\"authentik-server\"]
 IMG3[\"image: ghcr.io/goauthentik/server:2024.10<br/>command: server<br/>ports: host:9000 → 9000<br/>ports: host:9443 → 9443<br/>env_file: .env\"]
 end

 subgraph S4[\"authentik-worker\"]
 IMG4[\"image: ghcr.io/goauthentik/server:2024.10<br/>command: worker<br/>no ports<br/>env_file: .env\"]
 end
 end

 VOL[(\"📁 named volumes<br/>authentik-media<br/>authentik-certs\")]

 S3 -- \"mount<br/>/media + /certs\" --> VOL
 S4 -- \"mount<br/>/media + /certs\" --> VOL

 S3 -- \"depends_on<br/>service_healthy\" --> S1
 S3 -- \"depends_on<br/>service_started\" --> S2
 S4 -- \"depends_on<br/>service_healthy\" --> S1
 S4 -- \"depends_on<br/>service_started\" --> S2

 BROWSER[\"💻 Laptop Browser<br/>opens http://localhost:9000\"]
 BROWSER -- \"HTTP :9000<br/>HTTPS :9443\" --> S3

 classDef browser fill:#fff9c4,stroke:#f9a825,color:#000
 classDef pg fill:#fff3e0,stroke:#f57c00,color:#000
 classDef rd fill:#fde7e9,stroke:#c62828,color:#000
 classDef sv fill:#e3f2fd,stroke:#1976d2,color:#000
 classDef vol fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#2e7d32,color:#000
 classDef net fill:#f3e5f5,stroke:#6a1b9a,color:#000

 class BROWSER browser
 class S1 pg
 class S2 rd
 class S3,S4 sv
 class VOL vol
 class NET net
